title: Zero is a lower bound for every natural number
statement: For every natural number n, 0 <= n.

formal.statement: theorem Nat.zero_le : ((x0 : AxNat) -> AxNat.le AxNat.zero x0)

evidence.supports: Nat.zero_le is admitted by the trusted kernel gate with the type recorded in formal.statement.
evidence.checker_command: test "$(cargo run -q -p axeyum-lean-kernel --example nat_theorem_inventory -- zero_le 2>/dev/null | grep -Ec '^Nat\.zero_le[[:space:]]')" -ge 1
evidence.notes: `build_nat_prelude` admits this theorem only through the trusted kernel gate, so a successful build IS the type-check; the command both performs it and prints the admitted type, which is copied verbatim into formal.statement.
